name: Shear and Shine
headline:
Pet grooming in
Asheville.
leadText: Shear and Shine at 85 Weaverville Rd, Asheville. Directory listings say the shop grooms dogs and cats. Customers say friendly groomers, patient handling and beautiful results.
reviews: Great place to take your fur babies.
Hands down, the best place that I've had my dog groomed.
Shear-N-Shine did an amazing job grooming my Bichon, Buddy
Very accommodating and friendly. Groomer did an amazing job.
the staff was so sweet and professional with him!

theme.note: teal on the dark grooming photo

hoursNote: Closed Sunday and Monday. Shop hours from directory listings, call to confirm. Walk-in nail trimming runs Tuesday to Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM, from the shop’s Facebook.

services.d: Customers praise grooms for dogs of many breeds.
A customer describes an emergency clean-up for a very furry cat.
Tuesday to Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM, from the shop’s Facebook page.

qa.a: A customer wrote in a review: “Shear and shine is the best. They got me in for an immediate potty patch for my very furry cat who was in emergency need of being cleaned up.”

qa.q: Do I need an appointment for nail trimming?
qa.a: The shop’s Facebook page says nail trimming is walk-in, Tuesday to Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM. Other shop hours are Tuesday to Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM per directory listings. Please call to confirm.
Directory listings show Tuesday to Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM, closed Sunday and Monday. Walk-in nail trimming is 9 AM to 3 PM per the shop’s Facebook. Please call to confirm.
